subject: On-prem environment split & new cluster onboarding — Renewal coordination
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@terrainhealth.com>

Cc: infra-team@terrainhealth.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal coming up — request to split on-prem environment and add 2 clusters

Hi Camila,

Hope you had a good week — our renewal is coming up in July and as we reviewed our roadmap with infra, we need to make two changes to the private deployment we currently run with Redwood:

1) Environment split: we want to carve out a dedicated on-prem environment for our PHI workflows (segregated from analytics workloads) — same region, different VLANs and K8s namespaces.
2) Additional clusters: provision two additional GPU clusters at our new Boston site (estimated 4x A10g equivalent each) to support peak inference.

We anticipate a term adjustment to 24 months for the dedicated environments and would like to understand the pricing delta, procurement steps, and an estimated timeline for provisioning so we can align with our compliance window (end of Q3).

Attaching a high-level capacity sketch from our infra team (also copied here). Can we get a scope + SOW addendum and a target kickoff week?

Thanks,
Elena

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the sketch. This is doable and aligns with what other customers have done during renewal. Next steps I propose: 

- I'll draft a SOW addendum outlining environment separation (network segmentation + K8s tenancy), cluster sizing, and a 24-month term amendment.
- Aditya (cc'd) will validate the sizing assumptions and provide an estimated provisioning timeline.
- If procurement is ready, we'll prepare a DocuSign-ready addendum you can sign and return.

Quick Qs for scoping:
- Do you require fully air-gapped encryption HSM/KMS access at the Boston site or standard KMS over private links?
- Any specific data retention or audit-log retention beyond our default 90 days?

I'll attach an initial draft SOW addendum and a capacity worksheet for your infra to review. Can we aim for a technical kickoff the week of July 12th? That would give procurement time for PO.

Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — request to split on-prem environment and add 2 clusters

Camila / Elena — digging into the topology considerations. High level notes: 

- Environment split: we recommend network-level segregation + separate control-plane namespaces to avoid KV cache bleed and to enable per-tenant logging. We'll include an isolation checklist in the SOW: dedicated VMs for control-plane, RBAC lockdown, and strict egress rules.
- Provisioning timeline: once PO + signed addendum are in, staging to production for 2 clusters is ~6-7 weeks (2 weeks infra prep, 2 weeks cluster install/config, 2 weeks validation + compliance checks). If they need an expedited window, we can parallelize some steps for +2 weeks cost.
- HSM/KMS: if they require customer-managed HSM we need to add ~3 weeks for key provisioning and certificate rotations; suggest we flag that as optional line item.

I'll mark up the SOW where the technical assumptions live and include a minimal checklist for their auditors.

--
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
